name: Golden Boy
s: Ferit, the son of a wealthy family, is a womanizer. To get rid of his flirtatious ways, his grandfather Halis Ağa decides to marry him to the daughter of a close family from Gaziantep.

paragraphs.text: Yalı çapkını (English: The Golden Boy, also called Kingfisher) is a Turkish romance drama television series based on story created by Gülseren Budayıcıoğlu. The series revolves around a forced marriage with plenty of intrigue, lies, deception and dark family secrets.
